title: What One Shiver Does Inside You
topic: What happens under your skin in the few seconds of one shiver
question: What does one shiver do inside you?
hook: Feel that? A shiver. Frame 0: low over skin in macro, fine hairs lying flat; on 'A shiver' they rise in a slow wave.
payoff: The trembling has one job: it makes heat. Then the first picture is answered: the same signal lifts each hair. All of it happens without asking you.

story.thread: One cool breeze, followed from the skin's surface down to the muscle and back up, until the first picture explains itself.

beats.purpose: A feeling everyone knows, on a frame that is already composed.
Go under the surface: the skin feels the cool and tells the brain.
The open loop: the brain answers in two steps.
Step one: the small vessels near the skin narrow.
Step two: the muscles tremble on their own.
The payoff: trembling makes heat. One word on screen, then a picture-only hold.
The soft like/follow line, right after the payoff.
The callback: why the hairs rose in the first shot.
Back out to the first frame; the reframe; the loop.
